suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require thyroid cancer treated with thyroidectomy (and relevant neck dissection where applicable) followed by transient or permanent hypoparathyroidism. Post-thyroidectomy treatment complication; thyroid cancer itself is not the direct exposure. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
